title: HTML and CSS foundations
description: Kilnworth Pottery is a two-person studio on Saddler Street that makes mugs and bowls by hand and teaches evening classes, and it has never had a web page. Dilys, who runs it, typed what she wants into a text file, and Kofi wants people to find his classes. Starting from that file, you write the studio's page yourself and learn HTML and CSS from the very first tag.

parts.title: A page from a text file
